web.title: List of solar eclipses visible from the United States
web.description:
## California
One total solar eclipse occurred on [September 10, 1923](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Solar_eclipse_of_September_10,_1923), and the other will occur on [August 12, 2045](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Solar_eclipse_of_August_12,_2045).

## District of Columbia
[![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/7/70/2024_Total_Solar_Eclipse_%28NHQ202404080201%29.jpg/250px-2024_Total_Solar_Eclipse_%28NHQ202404080201%29.jpg)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:2024_Total_Solar_Eclipse_(NHQ202404080201).jpg) A view of the solar eclipse on [April 8, 2024](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Solar_eclipse_of_April_8,_2024) from [Washington, D.C.](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Washington,_D.C.) above the [Washington Monument](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Washington_Monument), during its partial phase

## New York
Three of the total solar eclipses occurred on [January 24, 1925](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Solar_eclipse_of_January_24,_1925); [October 2, 1959](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Solar_eclipse_of_October_2,_1959); and [April 8, 2024](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Solar_eclipse_of_April_8,_2024), respectively, and the remaining one will occur on [May 1, 2079](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Solar_eclipse_of_May_1,_2079).

## Pennsylvania
Two of the total solar eclipses occurred on [January 24, 1925](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Solar_eclipse_of_January_24,_1925) and [April 8, 2024](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Solar_eclipse_of_April_8,_2024), and the remaining two will occur on [May 1, 2079](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Solar_eclipse_of_May_1,_2079) and [September 14, 2099](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Solar_eclipse_of_September_14,_2099).

## Texas
One of the total solar eclipses occurred on [April 8, 2024](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Solar_eclipse_of_April_8,_2024), and the remaining three will occur on [August 12, 2045](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Solar_eclipse_of_August_12,_2045); [March 30, 2052](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Solar_eclipse_of_March_30,_2052); and [May 11, 2078](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Solar_eclipse_of_May_11,_2078).
